nox-sound.description:
Nox Sound — Stream, organize, and play your music effortlessly on Android.

• Direct YouTube Music Access: Connect your account to stream saved songs, explore recommendations, and sync your personal library.
• Unified Local & Online Playback: Play tracks stored on your device alongside online streams in one place.
• Uninterrupted Background Audio: Keep music running smoothly while multitasking with responsive lock-screen and queue controls.
• Live Synced Lyrics: Follow every beat with accurate, auto-scrolling lyrics timed to the track.
• Essential Daily Tools: Built-in sleep timer, quick favorites, custom playlists, and a distraction-free dark interface.
